finalText:
Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections at 02:14:07. Cache died, so every read hit the store direct. Store overloaded, timeouts at 5000ms began.

Queue depth climbed steady and passed the 500 cap at 02:29:12. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52, service down.

All 13 Redis reconnects failed. Log is dated 2026-07-04, not last night.
